title: Brand
description: A marketing name printed on products. A brand is not a company. One brand per file in brands/.

name.description: The brand name as it is normally written.

aliases.description: Alternative spellings, local-language forms and common transliterations.

brand_owner.description: id of the entity that owns the trademark.

sources.description: Where this record was checked. At least one must be a URL anyone can open.

verified_on.description: ISO 8601 date on which a human last checked this record against its sources.

example.description: true if this file is a seeded template rather than curated data.
